pages.title: Oil
pages.text: Oil sits underground in black pools. Collect it with a bucket or a liquid canister and put it in the refinery's slot.

pages.title: Refinery
pages.text: Power the refinery and pour in the oil. It is slow and very hungry, so give it several batteries or solar panels. It outputs fuel: collect that in empty canisters.

pages.name: Launch pad
pages.text: Nine pads in a 3x3 square. Place the rocket in the center.

pages.title: Fuel Loader
pages.text: Place the loader right next to the pad, power it and insert a canister. Fueling runs on its own. Get in, press $(k:Open Spaceship Inventory) to see fuel, cargo and your inventory, then $(k:jump) to launch.

pages.title: Rocket ready
pages.text: Pad, rocket and a loader with a canister.

pages.title: Oil
pages.text: Black liquid underground. The raw material for fuel.

pages.title: Fuel
pages.text: Yellow fuel for rockets, buggies and generators.

pages.title: Fuel Loader
pages.text: Moves fuel from a canister into the rocket.

pages.title: Launch Pad
pages.text: A rocket needs 9 of these blocks.
